text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'll go grab us something to eat! I
know the
perfect breakfast food! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the cafeteria one morning when I
hear an
energetic voice. I glance over
only to see
Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... I told Spe I hadn't eaten yet,
so she
invited me to breakfast. And
then...
choice_data_list_en: What... exactly is going on here?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The person behind Spe also asked me to
join, so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's no hassle at all... Making sure
Spe gets a
balanced breakfast shouldn't
be hard...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... I was just speaking with—
choice_data_list: ……もしかしてそこにいるのか？

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You've brought... quite a lot of food.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I got us ten hamburger steaks—enough
to feed an
army! And you can't have
breakfast without a kilo
of carrot pasta!
Plus, supersized fruit salad for
dessert!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eat this up and you'll be full of energy
all day
long! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eat this up and you'll be full of energy
all day
long! ♪
choice_data_list: 俺にも分けてもらっていいかな？
私にも分けてもらっていい？
全部食べて、元気いっぱいになろう！
choice_data_list_en: Could you share some with me, too?
Let's eat it all and fill up on energy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course! There's nothing more fun than
eating
together! ♪
choice_data_list: 俺にも分けてもらっていいかな？
私にも分けてもらっていい？
全部食べて、元気いっぱいになろう！
choice_data_list_en: Could you share some with me, too?
Let's eat it all and fill up on energy!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When you share your food, you get less
to eat...
but it leaves you more
satisfied...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I've still got some room over
here. Maybe
it's time for another
helping...
choice_data_list: バランスのいい食事だったな
バランスのいい食事だったね
choice_data_list_en: That was a nicely balanced meal.
That was a nicely balanced meal.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Well... they say that moderation is the
key to
good health...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how do you know one of my mom's
favorite
sayings?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe we talked about this
before. My
birth mother used to say that
all the time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, but I heard that from someone very
close to
you...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
O-oh! That makes sense! Was it Suzuka?
Hmm, or
maybe Sei...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe I should listen for once. I
guess that's
it for breakfast then!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Good choice...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Right. But first... we need to split up the
food.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's not fair... How come I'm left with all
the
salad...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't eat too much... And more
salad
means a more balanced meal...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Don't do this to me... At least give me
another
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Did someone just whack me on the
head?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Now then, let's eat.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nooo...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe goes on to polish off
her very
large breakfast.
